extracted.name: Everyday Cabbage Salad
extracted.description: Goes with practically anything. Think of it like Coleslaw - minus the mayo dressing. Great with light foods like seafood, and refreshing with hearty foods like stews and roasts. Chop the cabbage and keep in the fridge with the dressing in a jar, lasts for up to a week! Use just cabbage, and any colours you please. Can't-Stop-Eating-It-Delicious!
ingredient_lines: 2 cups shredded red cabbage ((or more green))
2 tbsp oil (vegetable or canola, or light olive oil)
instruction_lines: Shake Dressing ingredients in a jar. Start with 1 1/2 tbsp sugar and adjust to taste.
Place Salad ingredients in a large bowl. Pour over Dressing, toss. Set aside 20 minutes - mound will reduce by almost half and become juicy! Serve.
